Open Live TV plays free-to-air live streams that the broadcasters themselves publish on their own servers. The app has no accounts, no ads, no tracking and no DRM handling.

Streams can be limited to some regions or go offline at any time; that is decided by the broadcaster. Long-press a channel to add or remove it from the favorites.

Source and the list of streams: https://gitlab.com/wintechpartners1/open-live-tv
